{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] finely-grated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]]
*1 cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*¼ cup pasteurized egg product, or 2 pasteurized [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]], beaten
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]], [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]] to soft peaks

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except for whipped cream.
#Gently [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in the whipped cream.
#Refrigerate for 20 minutes and serve.

== Warnings ==

* You can use regular unpasteurized eggs, but they carry a risk of contracting a food-borne illness.
